about_short_description.short_description: Leap Wallet is a non-custodial Terra wallet offering access to dApps, staking, Defi, NFTs, and more on one platform.

product.name: Leap Wallet
product.description: A non-custodial multi-chain wallet for managing cryptocurrencies, NFTs, staking, and DeFi activities across 70+ chains and 150+ dApps.

product.name: Leap Dashboard
product.description: A portfolio tracker and management platform providing detailed overviews of tokens, DeFi positions, and staked assets across Cosmos chains.

product.name: Elements
product.description: A suite of integration tools for Cosmos dApps enabling user onboarding, liquidity management, and transaction facilitation.

product.name: SwapFast
product.description: A cross-chain token swap and bridging service supporting over 4,000 tokens and 60+ IBC-enabled chains.

product.name: Celestia Light Node Integration
product.description: Functionality within Leap Wallet allowing users to run a Celestia light node directly from the wallet to verify blocks and contribute to data availability.

product.name: Leap Bitcoin Wallet
product.description: A multi-chain wallet solution within Leap Wallet for managing Bitcoin including buying, selling, sending, receiving, and staking BTC.
